next.reason: 1985: 'Pseudo-text-1 must contain one or more text words.' §2023:7.2.3.3 SR6: 'Pseudo-text-1 shall contain one or more text-words, at least one of which shall be neither a separator comma nor a separator semicolon.' The added clause is not new: 1985 XII.2.3 SR9 already says pseudo-text-1 'must not consist entirely of a separator comma or a separator semicolon'. SR6 merges 1985 SR3 and SR9; same programs refused at compile time.
